notes.title: What's that? Another Update Already?
notes.content:
Hi all. Hope you are staying safe.

Today I have released version 1.2 of Squares Rage, which has some new features as well as some bug fixes. Most notably, I have improved the game in the following ways:

- 5 new characters have been added to the game! You can view who these characters are either in the game, or on their appropriate DLC pages on Steam!. Their names are Monocle Man, Dashing Dave, Crying Chris, Beat-Up-Black-Eye-Billy, and Facial Hair Frank.
(Note: Only 2 of the 5 characters' DLCs are available for download as of November 12. In the coming days, the rest of them will be released. I do apologize, I just need the green light to release the rest from Steam. This should not take too long, however).

- Also, I have noticed one person's review who was having trouble with the collision boxes on the spikes. I have now fixed the spikes collision boxes in all instances, so that the player will no longer die until they actually hit the spike.

That is all for now, more updates coming soon!

- Ajay

notes.title: SQUARES RAGE 1.1 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi all, hope you are doing well.

I have listened to feedback from multiple people and have released the following updates:

- Implemented 14 achievements for even more fun!
- Minor bug fixes with the music where two soundtracks would overlap occasionally. This is now fixed.
- Changed up the artwork a little bit for the backgrounds of some levels.

Stay tuned for great Squares Rage - related things, coming your way!

That's all for now!

- Ajay

notes.title: Achievements + other things
notes.content:
Hey, hope you are all doing fine during these troublesome times.

Recently I added some achievements to Squares Rage on the store page.

These are not yet functional with the game, but I plan on making them functional within the next few days. Thank you for understanding.

In the meantime, grab yourself a copy of squares rage, let me know how you like the game, etc. I promise you it's a blast!

I will post another announcement once the achievements are functional!

Have a nice day,

- A
